about: Flex's song library. The files are on the library-v1 release of github.com/jestrux/flex; Flex downloads a song the first time a film uses it (flex library pull fetches ahead). Grids: grids.json, measured by flex music, the phase checked on each song's drum stem.

songs.title: Brighter Morning
songs.energy: Quick lift then plateau: -20.7 dB intro to 15 s, +6.8 dB to a steady ~-13.9 dB body; a stripped vocal breakdown at bars 39-48 (drums/bass drop out, ~95-115 s), then a full-band return with brass to the end; outro drop at 135 s.
songs.sections: Intro with brass stabs 0-15 s > verse 20-37 s > chorus 37-56 s (with 'R-I-S-E' spell-out) > instrumental 56-93 s with brass riffs > stripped chorus breakdown 95-115 s > full instrumental finale 115-135 s > 'rise!' tag
songs.ending: clean: final 'rise!' and ~1 s decay to ~-22 dB below peak (soft tail)
suits: overview film with a quiet middle for narration (the stripped breakdown)
songs.source: Made with Suno (paid plan) for Flex, by Walter Kimaro
songs.licence: Flex Music Licence: free in any film, no credit needed; not resold as music on its own (LICENSE-MUSIC.md)

songs.title: Choir Lift
songs.energy: Staircase build in four steps: -24 dB intro > -20 at 10 s > -17.3 at 20 s > peak -13.3 at 40-55 s, then a breakdown (-20.4 at 55 s) and soft keys/choir outro (-22 at 67 s).
songs.sections: Synth/keys + choir intro 0-10 s > strings + bass 10-20 s > drums + percussion enter 20 s > full peak with guitar 40-55 s > breakdown to choir + keys 55-67 s > soft outro 67-72 s
songs.ending: soft keys/choir outro, faded over the last 2 s
suits: under narration (wordless vocals do not fight speech)
songs.source: Made with Suno (paid plan) for Flex, by Walter Kimaro
songs.licence: Flex Music Licence: free in any film, no credit needed; not resold as music on its own (LICENSE-MUSIC.md)

songs.sections: verses/choruses 0-57 s; final chorus lift 57-78 s; soft outro 78-83 s
songs.ending: soft outro, ending quietly (about -18 dB for the last 5 s, -24 dB at the cut)

songs.ending: clean hit: last hit ~97.8 s then ~1 s decay to ~-27 dB
suits: feature film with narration over the flute-led middle
